summary: A full pass that leaves a blocking finding open but fixes below-floor findings goes to a fix-check instead of stopping or re-running the full pass. The fix-check reads only the touched hunks, and when it finds nothing the loop ends 'done', so the open blocker is never named for the owner.
evidence: bun scratch script: nextStep({fullPasses:1,last:'full',fixedBelow:true,blockingOpen:true}) -> {step:'fix-check'}; nextStep({fullPasses:1,last:'fix-check'}) -> {step:'done'}. The `fixed` branch never checks h.blockingOpen before returning fix-check, and ship/sections/<reader>.md.tmpl decision 3.5 says 'A CRITICAL stops as decision 2; else decision 4'. docs/review-policy.md says a blocker still open after the last allowed step stops the run.

summary: Gate signals (gate-scan tagged hunks, scan unavailable, deleted paths) only raise the class when it is already code. A tests-only diff that skips a test or relaxes a threshold, which are the RH edits gstack-gate-diff tags in test paths, stays in the tests class and gets only the testing specialist: no <reader>, no adversarial pass, no <reader>.
evidence: planReview({paths:['test/foo.test.ts'], gateTagged:3, diffLines:400, history:{fullPasses:0,last:'none'}, ...}) -> class 'tests', dispatches ['specialist'], skipped <reader>/<reader>/<reader>. Same result with gateTagged:null (no fail-closed).

summary: docsClassPath counts any file whose basename starts with README/CHANGELOG/TODOS (case-insensitive), and anything under docs/ whatever its extension, as docs-class. A plan that changes code can then be detected as docs-only, which drops the Design/DX phases and the CEO <reader>.
evidence: docsClassPath('lib/todos.ts') -> true, 'bin/readme-lint.ts' -> true, 'scripts/changelog-gen.ts' -> true, 'docs/build.js' -> true; detectDocsOnly('- Edit README.md\n- Rewrite lib/todos-parser.ts') -> {docsOnly:true, code:[]}.

summary: The no-re-review path depends only on the severity of the decisions named in --incorporates, not on what the plan edit contains. One Low decision lets an arbitrarily large plan rewrite rebind every touched phase's reviewed hash without review, and at the round cap it also skips the capped-delta owner gate item.
evidence: quiet = severities.every(BELOW_HIGH) && touched.length>0 && !added.length && touched.every(closed) && docs-only unchanged; nothing compares the line diff to the decisions. When quiet, capped=[] and reopen=[], and ps.snapshot = newHash for every touched phase.

summary: nextStep sends a full pass that leaves a blocking finding open but fixed something below the floor to a fix-check, not stop. The fix-check reads only the touched hunks, and decision 3.5 continues to decision 4 when it finds nothing new, so the unfixed blocker is never named for the owner and the ship continues.
evidence: bun scratch: nextStep({fullPasses:1,last:'full',fixedBelow:true,blockingOpen:true}) -> {step:'fix-check'}; nextStep({fullPasses:1,last:'full',blockingOpen:true}) -> {step:'stop'}. Line 128 only stops on blockingOpen when !fixed; line 129/130 ignores blockingOpen. <reader>.md.tmpl 3.5: 'A CRITICAL stops as decision 2; else decision 4.'

summary: Gate signals (gate-scan tagged hunks, gate scan unavailable) are checked only when the diff already counts as code, so a tests-only diff that skips a test stays in the tests class. It gets only the testing specialist, with no <reader> and no adversarial pass, and an unavailable gate scan does not fail closed there.
evidence: bun scratch: classifyDiff({paths:['test/foo.test.ts'],gateTagged:3}) -> class 'tests'; gateTagged:null -> 'tests'; planReview dispatches only [testing], skipped <reader>/<reader>/<reader>. docs/review-policy.md lists 'a hunk the gate scan tags (... a skipped test)' as gate.

summary: Step 1's carry check still runs a single `carry --pr <n> --base <base>` with no --pregate. carry now refuses RECEIPT_CARRY_PREGATE_STALE for any receipt that records a pregate, so such receipts can never be carried and each run falls back to a full /ship. ship-policy.md describes a dry-run, then pregate, then carry --pregate sequence that the skill does not implement.
evidence: bin/gstack-ship-receipt cmdCarry: `else if (receipt.pregate && !rest.includes('--dry-run')) return refused('RECEIPT_CARRY_PREGATE_STALE', ...)`; ship/SKILL.md.tmpl:137-143 unchanged; docs/ship-policy.md 'Delta /ship: eligibility, then checks, then publication' steps 1-3.
